title: Add configurable request logging middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight, configurable request logger that records method, URL, status, response time, and optional headers. This enhances observability in production without adding external dependencies, aligning with yantraverse's zero‑dependency ethos.
testCases: Logs method, URL, status and response time for a successful GET request
Respects logger configuration: disables logging when 'enabled' is false
Includes custom header fields when 'extraHeaders' array is provided
Does not interfere with async route handlers or error propagation
acceptance: When enabled, the middleware outputs a correctly formatted log line for each request, includes configured extra headers, can be toggled off via config, and never alters the request/response flow or error handling.
reason: Production services need reliable request tracing for debugging and performance monitoring. Providing an out‑of‑the‑box logger eliminates the need for users to integrate third‑party tools, preserving the framework's lightweight and zero‑dependency promise while delivering high‑impact observability.
